summary: P06 iteration 2 passes the keep gate. The raw Windows primitive performs one direct CreateProcessW with a single STARTUPINFOEXW whose HANDLE_LIST names exactly the three child stdio pipe ends — canary handles are proven not inherited (with a child-side positive control proving the probe discriminates), the child emits nothing before resume and marks resume first, the explicit environment is exactly the provided map (parent env never leaks; fixed in this iteration by passing CREATE_UNICODE_ENVIRONMENT with a properly double-NUL-terminated UTF-16 block), resume is exactly-once, abort/Drop/terminate are fail-closed with no suspended-process leak and close-exactly-once handles, exit codes and identities track, and no console appears. The primitive is not wired into ProcessSupervisor — Job composition is P07. Note: cumulative Runtime counts use raw unfiltered cargo output; the rtk summary line truncates large suites (it under-reported 376 as 156 during P05, since corrected in the P05 evidence).
